observations: The page number «14» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. L01, L07 and L20: the headings of chapters 16-18, in bold, centred; in the left margin beside the heading of chapter 17 «O 102r», beside that of chapter 18 «C 48r, O 104v», the folios of the manuscripts at which the chapters begin.

L21-L24: the apogees: the sun two signs, 17 degrees and 55 minutes (as in chapter 8, p. 9, JP2 0041, L17); Saturn eight signs, 4 degrees, 55 minutes; Jupiter five signs, 22 degrees, 32 minutes; the list goes on on p. 15. L21: «Elaug», the apogee (al-awj), in italics.

N10: the bracket after «Quod autem» is printed broken, its head missing and a speck above it, so that it looks like a j; transcribed «]». N17: «{i:om.} O —», without a point after the siglum before the dash.
The colons and semicolons of the text stand after the thin space of the edition (8-12 px measured).

critical_notes.evidence: the readings of the manuscripts within a note are divided by commas; after the siglum M a full stop is printed before «tabula», as on pp. 9 and 10
the u of «iungetur», it shall be joined, is printed upside down, as an n
the note on «dakaicae» in L22 is note 29 («dakaicae{sup:29})»); the apparatus prints its number 28, a second time after the note 28 on «submissio»
